means: The constructed replays of the 基本的なドネイト page: none. The planner builds a terrain, then the page's own pieces off a build board, then fires the window; this page draws its donated pieces and the T on one board, so there is no build board to plan from. Every board is published unbuilt with its measured reason.
not_eligible_because: constructed, not played: a demo's queue, hold and key inputs would be ours. No claim id, no badge, no figure in any count.
caveat: a terrain's cell count decides whether any demo could stand on it from an empty board (odd: never; even but not a multiple of four: only with a line clear, which this planner never makes); the rest are unbuilt for want of a build board, not by measurement of the planner.
rules: a demo starts from an empty board, as every decoder does; the terrain is an exact cover of its grey cells by pieces the planner chose, every one reachable from spawn by the engine's own moves, no line cleared
the page's own pieces are a build board's lower-case letters, one whole piece per letter; this page has no build board
every board is unbuilt, with the reason read off the transcription: the terrain's cell count, or the missing build board
